title: A comparative cost and qualitative analysis for the transportation of green energy carriers
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,1773-1785
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE00959B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tom Kroon, Amir Fattahi, Francesco Dalla Longa, J. Chris Slootweg, Bob van der Zwaan
In this paper, we analyze the cost-optimality of transporting eight liquid or gaseous green energy carriers, including H2, via pipelines and shipping, over distances from 250 to 3000 km.
